description:
List the images this R3 account owns, with the URL to use for each one. That URL is exactly what R3ComponentTexture.url takes, so this is how you find the account's own artwork — a wood grain, a logo, a skybox — and then point a texture at it with r3_component_set.

Search by name rather than paging: search: "wood" is matched against every image on the account by the server, not against the page you happen to be holding.

Each row says whether it is a "texture" (an ordinary image for a material slot) or an "environment" map (.hdr / .exr). Those two are not interchangeable: an environment map belongs on Scene.environment, Scene.backgroundTexture or MaterialStandard.envMap, and renders as garbage in an ordinary map slot.

You cannot upload an existing image file from here — a tool argument is JSON, this server cannot read your disk, and a real texture is megabytes. A person uploads those in the R3 app. r3_image_create is the one exception: it takes a small image you generated yourself, such as a checkerboard or a gradient.
